task_description: Build a comprehensive multi-agent AI development system for the mayu project using Kiro Web and Kiro CLI. Create 11 specialized agent definitions (product-strategist, researcher, planner, architect, developer, reviewer, qa, devops, triage, marketer, devils-advocate), automated GitHub Actions workflows for agent-driven development lifecycle, and documentation/steering files that describe how agents coordinate to handle the full development cycle from idea to deployment.

verification.summary: All 11 agent JSON files validated with jq. All 6+1 YAML workflow files validated with PyYAML. Both steering markdown files exist with proper structure (240 and 540 lines respectively). Agent names are consistent between definitions and workflow references. This is a configuration-only task with no Go/TypeScript code changes.
